_comment: Examples whose tree does not survive parseHtml(toHtml(tree)) — each a documented HTML semantic, not a bug: 127, 129 a fence whose value starts with a newline (HTML drops the newline after <pre>); 369–468 emphasis nested in the same emphasis (the parser flattens a mark inside itself); 484, 487 a link with no content (an empty anchor is dropped); 596–601 autolinks with a scheme sanitizeUrl refuses (irc:, a+b+c:, made-up schemes). The list can only shrink.
